messages:
ada: Running through embed+rerank onboarding and hit a weird parity/format combo. Go sampleapp (runs in Docker) crashes when rerank zips scores after an auth-refresh race. Wanted to capture notes before I file a repro.

mike: Can you share SDK versions + minimal repro steps?

ada: Go SDK v0.9.1, JS helper v1.6.2 in the web client used for auth flow. Server infer v2026.03.21. Repro: force short-lived token expiry, enable batching helper pad_to_max=true, pipeline embed->rerank in a single request.

sora: Observed two separate issues: (A) name mismatch across SDKs: some return `vectors` others `embeddings`. (B) pad behavior differs: Go helper pads with `null` placeholders for missing slots while JS pads with numeric 0 or string "0" depending on codepath. That leads to mixed types in the envelope.

ben: Ops logs show replay pattern: initial request sees 401, web client triggers refresh and replays immediately, Docker sampleapp receives two near-identical requests and server returns a collapsed batch where some embedding slots are `null`. The rerank helper then zips scores (dense array) to candidates (sparse/nulls) and mis-assigns scores.

ada: Example raw response we saw (sanitized): ```json
{
  "request_id": "r_embed_42",
  "status": "ok",
  "embeddings": [[0.11,0.02,...], null, [0.30,0.12,...]],
  "scores": [0.92, 0.10, 0.87],
  "candidates": [{"id":"A"}, {"id":"B"}, {"id":"C"}]
}
```

mike: Oof. If `embeddings[1]` is null but `scores` is dense, index-based zipping will pair `0.10` with candidate C instead of B after a naive filter/zip.

sora: Short-term mitigations: 1) In onboarding docs, ask users to split pipeline into two calls (embed then rerank) until SDK patch lands. 2) Disable client-side auto-replay during auth refresh in web helper. 3) In the Go sampleapp, add defensive validation that rejects mismatched lengths before zipping and logs clear error with request_id.

ben: Proposed fixes: - Normalize server -> always include `embeddings` (accept `vectors` for backward compat). - Make pads consistent across SDKs: numeric 0.0 for dense float vectors, not string or null. - Ensure pipeline path pads any parallel arrays (scores) the same way and add length validation. - Add jittered backoff to auth-replay helper to avoid near-duplicate requests.

ada: I'll add a tiny repro fixture in repos/sampleapp/examples/embed-rerank-parity and file DEVEX-4001 with logs.

mike: I'll own SDK envelope normalization in Go SDK and coordinate with JS team to ensure helpers agree. Sora, can you own adding the defensive check in the sampleapp?

sora: Yep. I'll add an integration test that simulates a partial null batch and asserts we fail-fast with a clear error.

ci-bot: Scheduled: Go SDK patch v0.9.2 + JS helper v1.6.3 (padding + envelope normalization) -> canary next morning 08:00 PT.

ad a: Confirmed workaround works locally (split pipeline + disable auto-replay). Will update onboarding README with steps and link DEVEX-4001. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
